#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int l;
    string s;
    cin >> l >> s;

    int max_len = 0;
    int num_words = 0;
    int inside = 0;
    int cur_len = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < l; ++i) {
        char ch = s[i];

        if (ch == '(') {
            max_len = max(max_len, cur_len);
            cur_len = 0;
            inside = 1;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            if (cur_len != 0) num_words++;
            inside = 0;
            cur_len = 0;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inside == 1) {
                if (cur_len != 0) num_words++;
            } else {
                max_len = max(max_len, cur_len);
            }
            cur_len = 0;
        } else {
            cur_len++;
            if (i == l - 1) max_len = max(max_len, cur_len);
        }
    }

    cout << max_len << " " << num_words << endl;
    return 0;
}
